already-approved.description: An archivist returns one existing financing folder to its shelf.

already-settled.description: The destination custodian points to the token case already in her receiving tray while declining a second transfer request slip.

approval-signed.description: An older silver-haired Northbank adviser in navy signs one approval sheet and slides it toward Alice, dark bob hair, blue sweater.

branch-approved.description: Two workstations share a selected path through the consultation room.

branch-declined.description: A banker files the closure as the buyer prepares to leave.

buyer-authority.description: Alice retains the right to consent and perform her assigned review.

compilation-refused.description: Incompatible parts are set aside; no adapter has been built.

compiled-adapter.description: In a small bright workshop an engineer has assembled a finished blue connector that bridges a legacy application terminal and a new interface.

composer-direct.description: Banker and buyer arrange the proposed actions before signing.

continuation-waiting.description: Alice waits at a property-office counter beside an empty approval-card tray.

destination-ready.description: A female destination custodian places a prepared receipt permit in front of her empty receiving tray and signals readiness across the custody counter.

execution-boundaries.description: Two requests approach one available receiving slot.

generated-approved.description: A developer fits an adapter to a reviewed template.

generated-rejected.description: A generated housing leaves the original application lock intact.

input-invalid.description: Overhead application-inspection desk: a developer lifts a visibly broken incomplete package module from its box, with an open inspection tray beside it.

input-oversized.description: A developer holds an oversized but intact application package beside a small inspection opening; the package clearly cannot fit.

join-complete.description: An overhead view of two completed work folders being gathered by two different hands into one common archive sleeve.

join-waiting.description: Two colleagues at a shared desk: one finished blue folder lies ready, the other workstation has an empty chair and an open unfinished folder.

limits-checked.description: An engineer measures an orderly row of small workflow modules against a physical ruler boundary.

mapping-missing.description: An engineer opens an unfamiliar application module on the workbench and compares its unusual socket against the empty matching space in a set of reviewed adapter templates.

offer-opened.description: Alice and Ben, a dark-haired male agent in a white shirt, open a fresh empty property offer folder on the riverside house terrace.

package-builder.description: A developer unpacks an application for inspection.

path-fixed.description: Close view of a hand reaching toward a closed unused work folder while another hand gently points back to the already selected open folder.

plan-accepted.description: Overhead intimate desk scene: Alice signs the exact two-action plan offered by the older bank adviser.

position-locked.description: Close three-quarter view of a source custodian placing a transparent case of blue asset tokens into a fitted reservation cradle and closing a small padlock.

private-approval.description: Private documents remain behind the bank office partition.

proposal-prepared.description: Alice hands Ben a prepared blue property proposal folder with one signed financing sheet tucked inside.

proposal-received.description: Sofia, short-haired woman in a navy blazer, has received the blue proposal folder and places it carefully in her property office receiving tray.

proposal-refused.description: Ben returns the closed proposal folder to Alice; the property handoff cannot proceed.

proposal-relayed.description: Ben, dark-haired agent in white shirt, sends a single blue proposal envelope through an elegant property-office service hatch toward Sofia, a short-haired woman in a navy blazer.

purchase-approved.description: Alice prepares an offer during a property visit.

purchase-missing.description: An empty document sleeve waits in the offer folder.

purchase-rejected.description: Alice pauses outside the bank with her closed laptop.

purchase-reused-proof.description: One filed result and a second offer wait on the agent’s desk.

purchase-wrong-buyer.description: An agent compares two different buyer identities.

purchase-wrong-continuation.description: A clerk compares the intended next actions.

purchase-wrong-issuer.description: A document seal is compared with its issuing bank.

purchase-wrong-subject.description: Alice and Sofia compare two different property models.

result-published.description: Alice places a single signed approval card into a shared tray outside a frosted bank office partition.

retry-record.description: An archivist compares a newly arrived request slip against the single filed original request in a drawer, then places the new slip beside it.

review-complete.description: Alice closes the reviewed blue folder with a calm satisfied expression at her window seat.

review-waiting.description: An empty window seat with Alice's open laptop and blue review folder awaiting her return, afternoon light, cup of tea untouched, quiet anticipation.

sequence-complete.description: Alice reviews the next document at a quiet window seat.

sequence-resumed.description: Alice returns to her laptop and a bookmarked page.

settlement-waiting.description: A coordinator looks across two custody stations with an incomplete receipt-permit folder on the desk.

source-ready.description: A male source custodian stands beside the locked blue token case and raises a small confirmation card toward a female destination custodian across the counter.

trade-agreed.description: At a quiet custody desk the seller signs a transfer agreement while the source custodian watches.

transfer-approved.description: Two custodians prepare a single secured position for transfer.

transfer-final-leg-rejected.description: The locked position remains at the source beside a closed destination.

transfer-missing-agreement.description: Seller and custodian wait over an unsigned agreement.

transfer-missing-lock.description: A token box has not yet been placed in its reservation cradle.

transfer-missing-readiness.description: The destination custodian prepares the receiving space.

transfer-settled.description: The same two custodians after a coordinated transfer: left source cradle clearly empty and unlocked, right destination tray now contains the one transparent blue token case.

unselected-closure.description: The unused archive path is closed; the work folder remains outside.

workflow-rejected.description: The application stays on the bank’s side of the counter.
